headline: Profitability surges even as sales slip year over year
summary_short: Constellation Brands' revenue fell 3.3% y/y to $2,432.7M in FY2026 Q2, but operating income rose 18.4% to $845.3M and net income jumped 26.7% to $653.8M, lifting diluted EPS to $3.79 (+30.7% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue declined 3.3% y/y to $2,432.7M. Gross margin expanded roughly 390bp y/y to about 54.3% (from 50.4%), and operating margin expanded roughly 640bp to about 34.8% (from 28.4%), lifting operating income 18.4% to $845.3M despite the softer top line. Net income rose 26.7% to $653.8M (net margin up roughly 640bp y/y); diluted EPS rose 30.7% to $3.79. Operating cash flow rose 3.9% y/y to $661.8M; capex fell 8.1% to $177.2M.
